premise: UnifiedDB is authoritative semantic state; ClayGraph and retrieval indexes are derived. Authority requires an admitted published state commitment, not merely a healthy SQLite file or matching schema metadata.

ActualMaterializationAttestation.rule: both must match expected role-specific current values; stored metadata alone is not proof of actual materialization
ActualMaterializationAttestation.scope: drift detection, not semantic equivalence proof

RootDomainRegistry.rule: every persistent table/object crossing the semantic boundary has exactly one declared root-domain role; unclassified persistent state fails closed
RootDomainRegistry.self_reference_firebreak: ROOT_PUBLICATION_META is not included recursively in the content root it records

HierarchicalStateCommitment.leaves: deterministic table/domain roots over typed logical values and logical schema
HierarchicalStateCommitment.top: frank_state_commitment = H(protocol + ordered domain roots + selected schema/version identities)
HierarchicalStateCommitment.incremental_rule: authorized mutation recomputes dirty table/domain roots only; periodic/full recovery audit recomputes everything and must equal incremental commitment
HierarchicalStateCommitment.cache_authority: cached table roots are never sufficient without transaction-bound dirty tracking and audit

StatePublicationBarrier.phase_1: one authoritative DB transaction mutates state and records PREPARED publication receipt(parent_selected_head,new_content_commitment,tx_id,execution_binding)
StatePublicationBarrier.phase_2: external selected-head CAS advances parent -> new head bound to new commitment
StatePublicationBarrier.normal_open: only PUBLISHED commitment matching selected external head is runnable; PREPARED enters bounded recovery
crash_recovery: DB PREPARED + selector parent + DB commitment new => resume selector CAS
DB PREPARED + selector new => finalize PUBLISHED
DB old/rolled-back + selector new => fail closed
DB new + selector unrelated => fail closed
DB and selector both rolled back together => declared outer-failure-domain limitation

StateWitness.rule: model/GWT/Needle/effect-relevant reads carry a witness describing exactly which state produced the result
StateWitness.use_policy: observation may expose explicitly stale witness; authoritative mutation/effect reservation must revalidate/rebase witness against current selected head before effectful use

GraphProjectionWitness.rule: same numeric epoch is insufficient; current graph must be derived from the exact selected semantic root/head
GraphProjectionWitness.rebuild: same source root + same derivation program must reproduce the same deterministic graph projection root for deterministic surfaces

SelectionWitness.rule: retrieval rank/activation/salience is evidence about selection only and never mints truth or effect authority

StorageSafetyGate.wal: allow only when exact runtime build is proven fixed/backported or topology mechanically excludes the vulnerable race
StorageSafetyGate.rollback_journal: DELETE + synchronous FULL remains fail-closed fallback candidate
StorageSafetyGate.cross_file_migration_candidate: when rollback-journal mode is deliberately used, evaluate ATTACH + single transaction/super-journal for atomic UnifiedDB+ClayGraph schema transition; do not assume equivalent atomicity in WAL

ReplayAudit.audit_path: periodic full semantic commitment recomputation + deterministic replay from checkpoint/event cursor
ReplayAudit.acceptance: replayed commitment must equal published commitment; mismatch quarantines state

invariants: schema certificate metadata != actual materialization attestation
semantic root/hash != SELF or effect authority
query result without state witness cannot authorize a later mutation/effect after state turnover
root/publication metadata cannot recursively define the root it records
every authoritative write is bound to exact current execution generation and selected semantic lineage
derived projections are rebuildable and never outrank UnifiedDB published semantic state
negative results and rollback-domain limitations remain explicit
